biggest_catch: Within a day of inspection is fast - but the inspection is the gate, the quote can drop on assessment, and the Amazon gift card option is store credit, not money.
catches: The assessed value can differ from the instant quote if condition does not match; quotes can change.
Value varies by model, condition, and demand; Gazelle accepts a limited catalog of devices.
Amazon gift card payouts are store credit, not cash; checks take 5-10 business days to arrive.
If you decline a revised offer, return shipping is free - but you have waited the whole cycle.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

c1.evidence: Official gazelle.com sell pages document the trade-in program.

c2.evidence: Official pages: check, PayPal, or Amazon gift card payment.

c3.evidence: Official pages: paid within a day of inspection after receipt.

c4.evidence: Free instant quote and prepaid label; no upfront fee.

eligibility: US, 18+, must own the device; eligible models only.
maximize: Quote the same device on 2-3 buyback sites the same day and take the best - quotes are free. Turn off Find My and remove the activation lock before shipping; a locked phone can void the offer. Take PayPal over the Amazon gift card unless you'd spend at Amazon.
notes: Observed 2026-09-23 on gazelle.com official sell pages. Numeric keys are example-based estimates for a typical single item, labeled per lane rules; official terms give no payout floor and state value varies by condition and demand - actual offers are per-item and can be $0 if the item is not accepted.
payout_quote: Get an instant quote, ship free with our prepaid label; after we receive and assess your phone, we pay you within a day of inspection via check, PayPal, or Amazon gift card.

repeatable.cadence: You can do this once per device you own - it is bounded by the phones you already have, not a daily income stream.

s1.note: Shipping free; no seller fees stated.

s4.note: Quote is free with no obligation.

s5.note: Quote shown before you ship; free return if you decline a revision.

s6.note: Assessment can change the quote - disclosed.

steps: Describe your phone for an instant quote on gazelle.com
Accept and get the free prepaid shipping label
Ship the phone; Gazelle receives and assesses it
Paid within a day of inspection: check, PayPal, or Amazon gift card
timing: Paid within a day of inspection after receipt (check, PayPal, or Amazon gift card); free prepaid label.
who_pays: Gazelle - the buyback company pays you directly after assessing your phone.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device. Gazelle accepts a limited catalog of models - not every phone qualifies.
work_available: Yes - the program was live on gazelle.com as of 2026-09-23. It covers a limited catalog of phone models; value varies by model, condition, and demand.
what_gets_accepted: The assessed value can drop below the instant quote if the condition does not match. Turn off Find My and remove the activation lock before shipping - a locked phone can void the offer. If you decline a revised offer, return shipping is free.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free prepaid shipping, no fees. Your unpaid time is getting the quote, removing the activation lock, packaging, transit, and waiting for assessment - checks take 5-10 business days to arrive.
when_cash_arrives: Real money - paid within a day of inspection via PayPal or check. The Amazon gift card option is store credit, not cash; take PayPal instead unless you would spend at Amazon.
